Description:
The Foundation will support initiatives that promote environmental
conservation and the protection of endangered species. Key focus areas
include:
• Promoting clean energy transitions such as clean cooking technologies
and e-mobility.
• Protecting natural ecosystems by advocating for environmentally
friendly energy systems.
• Increasing forest cover through tree-planting initiatives around water
catchment areas, schools, and hospitals.
• Partnering with organisations to protect and conserve endangered
species in various regions across the country.
